model_policy: Model agnostic: use the organization's authorized model provider only
privacy_policy: No identifiable patient data to public models or repository; access authorization and manual de-identification required
approval_policy: AI cannot certify a hospital, finalize scoring, issue clinical orders, submit SAR, or externally publish without authorized human review

agents.responsibilities: task assignment, guardrails, workflow and final coordination
source and clause validation; standards edition and revision control
Part I organizational direction, staffing, policy and leadership
Part III clinical pathways, CLT/PCT and patient tracer
incident analysis, prevention, RCA and risk control
process design, improvement plans and learning cycles
measurement definitions, trends and denominator checks
draft 2026 SAR, hospital profile, PCT/CLT documents with traceable evidence
internal visit plan, panel coordination, triangulation and independent review
nonpunitive coaching, probing questions, 3C-DALI and empowerment evaluation; cannot approve own coached work
Parts I/II, governance, risk and operational system tracer across departments
Part III, patient safety, CLT/PCT and clinical pathway checks
patient/system tracers, interviews, observation, sample selection and evidence triangulation
findings registry, named owners, deadline and effectiveness recheck
information security and patient data protection
separate review of claims, evidence, scores and source validity

independence_policy: Facilitator cannot serve as independent confirming surveyor for the same coached scope. AI findings only; human-approved internal assessment; no official accreditation decision.
